changelog: Initial public release: create an agent inbox, simulate inbound email, inspect the thread, and reply with human approval.
summary: Run an autonomous email inbox with Drin — receive inbound email on a domain, read conversation threads, and reply in-thread. Use when building or operating an agent that must read and respond to email (support triage, scheduling, an "email me to do X" interface), set up inbound receiving, test the receive pipeline, or process new inbound messages and act on them.
